title: What came between Kingdom of Egypt and United Arab Republic?
question: What came between Kingdom of Egypt and United Arab Republic?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Kingdom of Egypt (1922) to United Arab Republic (1958): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: Middle Eastern state between 1958 and 1961 in the present territories of Egypt and Syria
